intensity: relative percent of the base peak (0-100)
note: Peak lists are truncated to the 40 most intense peaks and their intensities normalized to 100 at the base peak; `peaks_capped` marks a spectrum where that dropped peaks. Records with "peaks": null are pointer-only -- their license does not permit us to republish the fragments, so follow `url` to the original. An empty `license` means not established, never unrestricted.
